source_summary: Chinese landscape painting with misty water, distant washed hills, garden pavilions, tree groves, lotus surface, bridge, stream, rocks, and small scholar figures. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_mist_hills
motifs.description: Soft horizontal band of distant grey wash hills and cloud-like mist across the upper middle-right sky, isolated without the calligraphy or seal marks.
must_preserve: small darker pooled ink accents near center

motifs.name: lotus_water_shoal
motifs.description: Curving lotus-covered water surface and shoal in the middle-left, with clustered round leaves fading into pale water and a gently arcing shoreline.
must_preserve: blue-green and muted pink color accents
scattered dot texture along the bank

motifs.name: rear_grove_and_island_pavilions
motifs.description: Midground island garden with a round thatched pavilion, partial tiled building to the right, surrounding shrubs, bare trees, bamboo-like verticals, and a distant conifer grove behind.
must_preserve: round pavilion roof geometry with fine thatch strokes
partial rectangular tiled roof at far right
blue-green shrub washes and dot clusters

motifs.name: foreground_scholar_pavilion
motifs.description: Raised waterside pavilion at right-center containing a seated scholar beside a low table, with tiled roof, open railing, support posts, and water reflections beneath.
must_preserve: seated scholar figure with robe lines
short vertical reflection strokes below the platform

motifs.name: arching_willow_frame
motifs.description: Large dark-trunked willow-like tree mass on the right, arching over the buildings with long drooping branches and sparse foliage clusters.
must_preserve: overlapping branches crossing the pavilion roofs
contrast between heavy ink trunk and pale washes

motifs.name: lower_right_pavilion_with_attendant
motifs.description: Lower-right waterside pavilion with tiled roof and open lattice walls, containing a small seated figure near the right side, set on a slight bank above water.
must_preserve: open wall lattice and diagonal braces

motifs.name: bridge_stream_and_walking_scholar
motifs.description: Lower-left stream crossing with a small plank bridge, grassy banks, and a walking scholar holding a staff along the path to the right of the bridge.
must_preserve: simple plank bridge with two posts

motifs.name: central_foreground_tree_grove_and_rocks
motifs.description: Central foreground grove of slender trees and shrubs rising from grassy mounds, with exposed roots and clustered rocks at the base.
must_preserve: slender trunks with fine branch linework
rounded rocks with dark contour cracks
varied ink density between foliage masses

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
